questions.question: কোনটি ‘Panic’ শব্দের সমার্থক শব্দ?
questions.explanation: 'Panic' শব্দের অর্থ হঠাৎ তীব্র ভীতি বা আতঙ্ক। এর উপযুক্ত সমার্থক শব্দ হলো 'Horror' (আতঙ্ক বা চরম ভয়)।

questions.question: কোনটি ‘Gain’ শব্দের সমার্থক শব্দ?
questions.explanation: 'Gain' শব্দের অর্থ লাভ, অর্জন বা সুবিধা। এর উপযুক্ত সমার্থক শব্দ হলো 'Advantage' (সুবিধা বা লাভ)।

questions.question: He made me drive his car’ বাক্যটির Passive form –

options.ক: I am made to drive his car by him.
options.খ: I was made driven his car to him.
options.গ: I was made drive his car by him.
options.ঘ: I was made to drive his car by him.

questions.explanation: Active voice-এ Causative 'make'-এর পরে Bare Infinitive (drive) বসলেও Passive voice-এ 'to' যুক্ত হয়: 'I was made to drive his car by him.'

questions.question: ‘My uncle looks after me’ বাক্যটির Passive form হচ্ছে-

options.ক: I am look after by my uncle.
options.খ: I am looked after by my uncle.
options.গ: I was looked after by my uncle.
options.ঘ: I am being looked after by my uncle.

questions.explanation: Present Indefinite Active 'My uncle looks after me'-এর Passive রূপ হলো: 'I am looked after by my uncle.'

questions.question: কোনটি Common Noun ?
questions.explanation: 'Month' শব্দটি দিয়ে যেকোনো মাসকে সাধারণভাবে বোঝানোয় এটি Common Noun। February হলো Proper Noun, Jute হলো Material Noun এবং Class হলো Collective Noun।

questions.question: ‘Accept’ শব্দটির Noun হবে-
questions.explanation: 'Accept' (গ্রহণ করা) verb-টির Noun form হলো 'Acceptance' (গ্রহণযোগ্যতা বা স্বীকৃতি)। Acceptable হলো adjective।

questions.question: I said to you, “He has done his duty.” বাক্যটির Indirect speech হবে-

options.ক: I said to you that you have done your duty.
options.খ: I said to you that he had done his duty.
options.গ: I told you that you had done your duty.
options.ঘ: I told you that he has done his duty.

questions.explanation: Reporting verb past tense-এ থাকায় এবং direct speech-এ Present Perfect (has done) থাকায় তা Indirect-এ Past Perfect (had done) হবে: 'I said to you that he had done his duty.'

questions.question: “The Captain ordered the soldiers to march on বাক্যটির direct speech হবে-

options.ক: The Captain asked, “Soldiers, I ask you to march.
options.খ: The Captain said to the soldiers,”Please march on
options.গ: The Captain said, “Soldiers, I ask you to march on.”
options.ঘ: The Captain said to the soldiers, “March on.”

questions.explanation: সৈন্যদের মার্চ করার আদেশ দেওয়ার Direct রূপ: The Captain said to the soldiers, 'March on.'
